THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No. RBK/LAN/AQURE/A3/84. Land and Land Development Ref. No. 4-3/11/2016/Z/364. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose: Description of the land to be acquired: Allotments of land described below and depicted in Cadastral Map No. 610212 of Surveyor General, Zone No. 02 sheet 02, situated in the Village of Yodagama belonged to Grama Niladhari Division of No. 09B Yodagama in Divisional Secretary's Division of Rambukkana in Kegalle District in Sabaragamuwa Province.

01. Lot No. 01 Name of Land: Purana Asseduma, Dangahamula Asseduma; Description: Paddy Field; Original Claimants: D. P. Gunapala; Extent: 0.0947 Hectare. 02. Lot No. 02 Name of Land: Purana Asseduma, Dangahamula Asseduma; Description: Paddy Field; Original Claimants: Not found; Extent: 0.0353 Hectare. 03. Lot No. 03 Name of Land: Purana Asseduma, Dangahamula Asseduma; Description: Paddy Field; Original Claimants: Not found; Extent: 0.0300 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/servitude are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat Rambukkana on the 20th day of March 2024 at 10.00 a.m. Further, it is hereby notified me in writing (in duplicate) before 05th day of March 2024, regarding the nature of their interests in the land/lands, particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
